title: The Masnavi Begins
hook: After Shams, Rumi found a friend who could hold a pen.

segments.fa: ای ضیاء الحق حسام الدین توی
segments.en: O Ziya al-Haqq, Husam al-Din, it is you

segments.fa: که گذشت از مه به نورت مثنوی
segments.en: by whose light the Masnavi has passed beyond the moon.

tafsir: His name was Husam al-Din Chalabi.
He asked Rumi for a long poem, like those of Sanai and Attar.
Rumi spoke the verses. Husam wrote them down, often through the night.
It grew into six books: the Masnavi.
Ziya al-Haqq means the light of the truth.
Rumi gives that light to his friend, not to himself.

outro.say: Part nine. What is Rumi's wedding night? Follow The Guest House.
